scientific_integrity: All mathematical claims refer to the stated graph class and are proved with an exhaustive finite-state lemma; finite graph brute force is an independent check, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple labelled prisms C_n square K_2, n at least 3, only unweighted perfect edge domination.
No conclusion for unrestricted cylindrical grids, orbit counts, or ordinary edge domination.
Full primary text of arXiv:2607.03894v1 was inaccessible during this review; historical priority remains qualified.
The 512-triple fixed-state enumeration is checked by transparent executable code, not independently formally certified.
title: Perfect edge domination of circular ladder graphs
